title: Espresso Shot Extraction Consistency
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=espresso:shot
| eval ratio=round(yield_g/dose_g,2)
| stats avg(shot_time_s) as avg_time, stdev(shot_time_s) as time_sd, avg(ratio) as avg_ratio by bean
| eval consistency=if(time_sd<3,"dialed in","variable")
| sort - avg_ratio
description: Tracks your espresso shot time and brew ratio per bean so you can tell when a coffee is dialed in versus all over the place.
value: Great espresso is repeatable espresso; measuring shot-time variation shows whether your grind is dialed in or still guesswork.
implementation: Log each shot's dose, yield, and time to `index=personal`; review consistency per bean to fine-tune the grinder.
visualization: Table of beans with average shot time, ratio, and a consistency label.
grandmaExplanation: It records how your espresso shots turn out so you can see when a coffee is perfectly tuned and when it needs adjusting.
